title: Native Trails NSL1915-S Nipomo NativeStone Bathroom Sink (Slate)

comparisons.notes: Native Trails Nipomo NSL1915-S, Slate, same model
Native Trails Nipomo 20in NSL1915-S Slate, in stock

writeup: Native Trails' Nipomo sink (model NSL1915-S) is a 19.5 x 15 inch rectangular NativeStone concrete basin in the Slate finish. Woot has it new for $318.99, while PatioLiving and The Sink Boutique both list the same model at $642, so it's roughly half price. Only one was showing at detection.
